Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Query ServiceOrders for the current scope ($$KANBAN_SCOPE) and push a paginated JSON page + meta to the kanban web viewer wv_ServiceOrdersKanban.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: SCOPE: $$KANBAN_SCOPE = {"periodMode":"day|week|month","anchorDate":"YYYY-MM-DD","statuses":[...],"offset":N,"limit":N}. Empty/missing keys fall back to day / today / [] / 0 / 100.

Value.Calculation: If ( not IsEmpty ( $$KANBAN_SCOPE ) and Left ( $$KANBAN_SCOPE ; 1 ) = "{" ; $$KANBAN_SCOPE ; "{}" )
Let ( p = JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "periodMode" ) ; If ( IsEmpty ( p ) or p = "?" ; "day" ; p ) )
Let ( a = JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "anchorDate" ) ; If ( IsEmpty ( a ) or a = "?" ; $today ; a ) )
Let ( s = JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "statuses" ) ; If ( Left ( s ; 1 ) = "[" ; s ; "[]" ) )
Let ( l = GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "limit" ) ) ; If ( l > 0 ; l ; 100 ) )
Let ( o = GetAsNumber ( JSONGetElement ( $scope ; "offset" ) ) ; If ( o > 0 ; o ; 0 ) )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Compute date window (from/to) from periodMode + anchorDate

Value.Calculation: Date ( Middle ( $anchorStr ; 6 ; 2 ) ; Right ( $anchorStr ; 2 ) ; Left ( $anchorStr ; 4 ) )
Year ( $fromD ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Month ( $fromD ) ; 2 ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Day ( $fromD ) ; 2 )
Year ( $toD ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Month ( $toD ) ; 2 ) & "-" & Right ( "0" & Day ( $toD ) ; 2 )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Build WHERE clause — date window + optional status IN (...)

Value.Calculation: "WHERE so.JobDate BETWEEN DATE '" & $fromISO & "' AND DATE '" & $toISO & "'"
ValueCount ( JSONListKeys ( $statuses ; "" ) )
" AND so.Status IN ("
$statusClause & If ( $i > 0 ; ", " ; "" ) & "'" & Substitute ( JSONGetElement ( $statuses ; $i ) ; "'" ; "''" ) & "'"
$where & $statusClause & ")"

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: MARK: Total count + clamp offset to a valid page, then persist normalized scope

Value.Calculation: GetAsNumber ( ExecuteSQL ( "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ServiceOrders so " & $where ; "" ; "" ) )
If ( $offset ≥ $total ; Max ( 0 ; Int ( Max ( 0 ; $total - 1 ) / $limit ) * $limit ) ; $offset )

"SELECT so.PrimaryKey, so.ServiceOrderNumber, so.Status, so.ClientName_Calculation, so.VehicleName_Display, so.Description, so.JobDate, so.JobTime, so.JobTimeEnd" & " FROM ServiceOrders so " & $where & " ORDER BY so.JobDate, so.JobTime" & " OFFSET " & $offset & " ROWS FETCH FIRST " & $limit & " ROWS ONLY"
ExecuteSQL ( $sql ; "|" ; "¶" )
